page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with diagrams (semicircles) between paragraphs; a handwritten note fragment in the right margin (not printed text); a digitiser's banner at the foot (not transcribed); catchword/signature at the foot right: "C 3" is a signature.

main_text.l: plana, quæ continetur diametro Circuli, & ea
linea quam à toto ambitu diameter abscindit.
linea recta & parte lineæ ambitus continentur.
et parte ambitus dimidio maiore comprehenditur.
Minus, ἀλύσις græce, parte ambitus dimidio mi-
et profunditatem habet, effingitur superficiei transitu situ

page.notes: Diagrams of semicircles appear three times (unlabelled except a letter α at top and ε, γ at the sides of the second). Greek words are transcribed as legible; the Greek in the third paragraph ("ἀλύσις"-like) is uncertain. The final line is partly cut off at the right edge ("tran" / "situ" likely "transitu" split across lines). Handwritten marginal annotations on the right are not printed text and were omitted.
